principles: A diagram is not a proof and visual appearance never creates a mathematical fact.
Every scored Core item has exactly one assessed skill; supporting skills do not receive automatic mastery credit.
KNTT Core is determined by reviewed curriculum mappings, not by Entrance10 frequency or legacy bank membership.
Geometry statements separate givens, constructions, targets and derived relations.
Proof steps use claim + reason; theorem converses may be used only when their hypotheses are satisfied.
SVG is the preferred diagram format; coordinates come from a diagram spec or verified construction, not eyeballing.
Formative practice evidence and Core Readiness evidence remain separate; Soft Mastery only.

layers.KNTT-Core: Curriculum skills from reviewed PRIMARY mappings, including reviewed proposed skills.
layers.Core-Support: Prerequisite/representation skill taught to make Core understandable but not independently gated unless source-mapped.
layers.Entrance10: Exam-oriented geometry methods/results outside the mapped Core.
layers.Specialized-Challenge: High-complexity proof or enrichment; never gates Core.

learning_flow.practice: Interactive bank + written proof/construction practice with collapsed hints/solutions.

statement_contract.rule: No relation may appear as a given merely because the drawing looks that way.

step_shape.reason: definition / given / theorem / previously established claim

forbidden: using a diagram as the reason for equality, parallelism, perpendicularity, tangency or cyclicity
using a theorem converse without checking its hypotheses
assuming a point lies between two others from visual placement alone
claiming corresponding vertices in congruent/similar triangles without explicit correspondence
dual_review_required: canonical proof templates reused across the bank

diagram_contract.essential_rule: New or materially rewritten items with an essential diagram require a machine-readable diagram spec.
diagram_contract.supporting_rule: Supporting diagrams must not encode an unstated relation by markers, labels or exact-looking placement.
accessibility: alt text describes mathematical configuration, not decorative appearance
caption states not-to-scale when metric appearance is non-authoritative

item_contract.assessed_skill_rule: Exactly one assessed skill for scored Core micro/readiness items.
item_contract.distractor_rule: Wrong options should correspond to plausible geometry misconceptions; no option may be made correct only by reading the drawing to scale.
item_contract.diagram_rule: If diagram is essential, the question must still state all logical givens needed for the intended proof/calculation.

coverage_policy.exact_id_gap_rule: Treat exact ID gaps as authoring candidates only after semantic reuse review.
coverage_policy.core_readiness_rule: Only mapped Core skills can contribute to readiness.

rollout_batches.reason: foundational proof language and triangle-center semantics
circle proof transitions plus the largest Core coverage gap and 3D measurement

benchmark_policy.rule: Architecture or diagram-generation changes must preserve BENCH-GEO-001 and future approved geometry benchmarks.

freeze_gate: Gemini independent architecture/pedagogy review completed with source-aligned evidence.
Coverage matrix exact-ID calculations pass automated QA.
Diagram schema and authoring template pass QA.
At least one migrated geometry topic passes desktop/mobile/iPad Learn→Practice→Readiness flow.
